subject: Compact site-week demo — options for compressed travel window
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@harborhealth.org>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sasha Tully <sasha.tully@harborhealth.org>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HarborHealth site week — demo timing conflict

Hi Lauren / Sasha,

Quick note from the HarborHealth scheduling team: our VP of Ops and two end users are on a shortened travel window the week of Sept 14 — a conference was extended and one key participant tacked on a short family trip. That means we can no longer block a continuous 60–75 minute walkthrough on-site.

We still really want to see the end-to-end flow and discuss rollout concerns, but we need a lighter touch. Can you propose alternatives? Options we discussed internally:
- Split the session into two 25–30 minute focused segments (admin/IT + clinical use cases) separated by a day, OR
- Send a short recorded product tour (20–25 min) in advance, then do a 30-minute live Q&A when the exec is available.

I attached the draft agenda we planned to cover (high-level). If you have an option that includes a brief async capture + a short live session, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Director, Clinical Ops Programs
HarborHealth

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>

On Tue, Sep 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM Emily Park <emily.park@harborhealth.org> wrote:
> Quick note from the HarborHealth scheduling team: our VP of Ops and two end users are on a shortened travel window the week of Sept 14 ...

Thanks for the heads-up, Emily — totally understand. We can absolutely make this compact without losing the key decision points. Two practical paths that have worked well for other site-week customers: 

1) Split, focused walk-throughs
- Day 1 (30 min): Admin, security, deployment/IT concerns (Priya leads)
- Day 2 (30 min): Clinical workflows + end-user scenarios (Marissa leads)
- Deliverable: 10–15 min highlights recording of the clinical flow for exec review

2) Async + live Q&A (recommended if travel makes contiguous blocks hard)
- We record a 20–25 min guided product tour covering the agenda you attached (we'll include captions and chapters).
- We share the recording 48 hours before the live slot.
- Live slot: 30-minute Q&A + scoping (we'll keep a 10-minute buffer to cover procurement/next steps).

I attached a stripped-down sample recording we can reuse and an .ics with a couple of calendar slots (Sept 15/16 windows). If you prefer the split option, we can propose two calendar windows instead.

Which would you prefer? If you choose async + Q&A, tell us the best live slot (we can be flexible before 1pm PT).

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Emily — happy to help with either approach. For the async + Q&A path we can: 
- Produce a 20-minute walkthrough focused on two clinical scenarios you flagged (med reconciliation + discharge notes).
- Provide a one-page checklist for IT to validate (network, token/key access, on-prem considerations) so Priya can triage.

If you want the split sessions, I can own the clinical slot and record a short 8–10 minute highlights clip for the exec. Priya — if you can lead the IT/admin segment we should be set.

Hi Lauren / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and options. We discussed internally and would like to go with option 2 (async + live Q&A). The exec will likely only watch while traveling, so the recording plus a compact Q&A is ideal. Proposed live slot: Sept 15, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — that gives us time to preview the recording on Sept 13/14.

Next requests:
- Can you send the recording link no later than Sept 13 (we'll share it with a small exec group)?
- Please include closed captions and a one-page IT checklist in the same folder.

If that works for you I'll confirm via calendar invite. Appreciate the flexibility — excited to move forward.

Best,
